name: Old Town Scottsdale
sub: Walkable art galleries, rooftop dining, and luxury condos in the heart of Scottsdale.
about: Old Town Scottsdale blends gallery-lined streets, nightlife, and high-rise condo living just minutes from Camelback Mountain and Fashion Square. It's the walkable core of the Valley's most recognizable luxury market.
schools: Zoned to Scottsdale Unified School District: Tavan Elementary, Mohave Middle School, Coronado High School.
commute: Central to the Valley via SR-101 and Scottsdale Rd. Average commute to Sky Harbor Airport: 20–25 minutes.

name: Arcadia
sub: Mid-century ranch homes, citrus-grove heritage, and some of Phoenix's best patio dining.
about: Arcadia is Phoenix's most coveted in-town neighborhood — wide lots, mature citrus trees, and mid-century ranch architecture beneath Camelback Mountain, a short drive from both Old Town Scottsdale and downtown Phoenix.
schools: Zoned to Madison School District: Madison Simis Elementary, Madison Meadows Middle School, Arcadia High School.
commute: Central location near SR-51 (Piestewa Freeway). Average commute to downtown Phoenix: 12–18 minutes.

name: Gilbert
sub: Family-friendly master-planned communities with top-rated schools in the East Valley.
about: Gilbert is one of the fastest-growing family markets in the Valley, known for highly rated Gilbert Public Schools, master-planned communities, and easy access to the East Valley tech corridor.
schools: Zoned to Gilbert Public Schools: Gilbert Elementary, Mesquite Junior High, Gilbert High School.
commute: Convenient to US-60 and Loop 202. Average commute to downtown Phoenix: 30–40 minutes.

name: Paradise Valley
sub: Ultra-luxury desert estates with Camelback and Mummy Mountain views.
about: Paradise Valley offers some of the most exclusive addresses in Arizona — sprawling desert estates, resort-caliber privacy, and unmatched mountain views, tucked between Phoenix and Scottsdale.
schools: Zoned to Scottsdale Unified / Paradise Valley Unified: Kiva Elementary, Cocopah Middle School, Chaparral High School.
commute: Central to both Phoenix and Scottsdale via Lincoln Dr and SR-51. Average commute to Old Town Scottsdale: 10–15 minutes.
